newsitem.title: USA: Cummins shares up after earnings beat estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cummins shares up after earnings beat estimates.

text.p: Cummins Engine Co Inc shares were up about 2.7 percent Wednesday after second quarter earnings exceeded analysts'estimates.

The diesel engine supplier reported net income of $53 million or $1.39 a share in the second quarter, compared to $44 million or $1.10 a share a year ago. The consensus forecast was $1.26 a share, according to First Call.
Cummins said sales of heavy-duty truck engines were boosted by increased international shipments.
The company reported sales of $331 million to the heavy-duty truck market, up seven percent from a year ago.

Midrange truck engine sales of $143 million were seven percent lower than the year-ago quarter as a result of lower demand in North America, Cummins said. Sales of $152 million to the bus and light commercial vehicle market were essentially level with second-quarter 1996 levels, in spite of lower engine sales to Chrysler Corp resulting from a strike affecting Dodge Ram pickup truck plants, Cummins said.
Power generation sales of $302 million were slightly lower than the year-ago quarter, while industrial sales of $263 million were 26 percent higher than the second quarter of 1996, Cummins said.

Sales of filtration and other products were $205 million, 11 percent higher than the second quarter of 1996, due to stronger sales of filtration products and an improvement in the European market for turbochargers, Cummins said.
Cummins Engine shares were up two at 71-3/4 Wednesday.
